surface: src/plate_core/pr_babysit.py (new get_actionable_review_threads helper + docstring), src/plate_core/mcp_server.py (plate_get_actionable_review_threads MCP tool + import), src/plate_core/agent_guidance.py (Full PR Green + review thread bullets), AGENTS.md (babysit section + steps), plugin/agents/plate.agent.md (babysit bullet), tests/test_pr_babysit.py (regression test)
summary: Encapsulate review thread handling (GraphQL pagination, databaseId, body/author extraction, resolveReviewThread mutation) behind high-level public helpers get_actionable_review_threads + resolve_review_thread (and plate_* MCP equivalents via babysit_pr / get_pr_merge_gates). Add plate_get_actionable_review_threads MCP tool. Strengthen guidance, AGENTS, persona to mandate the encapsulated surfaces and explicitly forbid hand-rolling raw GraphQL/jq/mktemp/sed/NO_COLOR/ANSI commands. Add regression test. (Addresses #516.)
migration_impact: Agents must now route all review thread discovery + resolution through pr-babysit skill surfaces (babysit_pr, get_actionable_review_threads, resolve_review_thread, plate_pr_babysit, plate_get_actionable_review_threads, plate_resolve_review_thread). Raw low-level GraphQL recipes are no longer to be used or taught in agent flows. Downstream repos get more reliable, less error-prone feedback resolution in babysit/green loops. No other config changes.
agent_notes: For any PR feedback, babysit, or 'get green': use plate_pr_babysit (or Python babysit_pr) to detect actionable threads, plate_get_actionable_review_threads (or get_actionable_review_threads) to list them with full details, and plate_resolve_review_thread / resolve_review_thread to mark resolved after fixes. The helpers manage pagination (first:100), databaseId from comments.nodes, author matching (default third-party patterns or provided), safe bodies. Never emit or execute your own gh api graphql + jq + mktemp + sed for threads. See updated pr_babysit docstring, guidance Full PR Green section, and AGENTS babysit steps. (Addresses #516, builds on #520 resolve requirement and #519/#526 full-green loop.)
